[Section] Materials and Methods ::: Data
[source_id=22] Two datasets are exploited in this article. Both datasets consist of plain text containing clinical narrative written in Spanish, and their respective manual annotations of sensitive information in BRAT BIBREF13 standoff format. In order to feed the data to the different algorithms presented in Section SECREF7, these datasets were transformed to comply with the commonly used BIO sequence representation scheme BIBREF14.
